facts.fact: Juba City Council's notice of 21 October 2022 invites all businesses within the council and its blocks to register their data at the block headquarters offices on a new digital revenue collection and management system; registration and service access had started, and manual payments for council services are to end (office order No 11/2022 of 4 October 2022).
facts.system: JCC Digital Revenue Collection & Management System

facts.fact: The system's roll out covers only Juba City Council and its four blocks (HQ, Juba, Kator, Munuki, Environment as the notice lists them); it is announced as just started, with no other local government named.
facts.system: JCC Digital Revenue Collection & Management System

facts.fact: Stateman Software & Telecom Ltd is named as the developer, implementer and managing company of the system, working in partnership with the council.
facts.system: JCC Digital Revenue Collection & Management System

facts.fact: On 4 October 2022 the Juba mayor issued an office order to roll out digitalised revenue collection in the city and its block councils, ending manual payments.
